name: Hierarchical Term Formatter
description: Provides hierarchical term formatters for taxonomy reference fields.
project_description:
This module provides hierarchical term formatters for taxonomy reference fields. In other words, it can display a taxonomy term reference on, say, a node as Parent > Child , rather than just Child .

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Uses standard taxonomy term reference fields. 
 Displays all parents of the referenced term, in addition to the term itself. Can also be configured to only show the parents, or just the root parent term. 
 Optionally links terms to their term pages. 
 Control the markup that wraps and separates the terms. 
 
 Back to top 

 Usage 
 Install and enable the module. Go to Admin » Structure » Content types and open the Display settings page for a taxonomy term field. (Taxonomy term fields may also be available on other entities than nodes.)

 Choose the Hierarchical terms formatter and click the cog wheel to configure the formatter.

 Back to top
